extraction.Name: Annie Utterback (deceased)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded November 16, 1920, by Richard Jones
extraction.Buyer: Annie Traversie and Dave Traversie, husband, conveyed this land to J. E. Utterback for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739667 issued; Lots 5 and 6, and East half of Southwest quarter section 7, township 44, north of range 32; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee April 3, 1920; conveyance dated December 13, 1920; allottee deceased

extraction.Name: Maud Utterback
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 10, 1919 by Stephen F. Estes
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612457 issued; Lots 3 and 4, and the North half of Southeast quarter, section 12, township 44, north of range 58; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee but not dated; the 1927 and prior taxes have been paid and there appears to be no other encumbrance against the land
